stem.en: Add the boy-to-man difference to princess. The top word is prince, not queen, and prince was already the nearest word to princess. What is the best conclusion?

text.en: The embedding of princess must be broken
More training would make this sum always work
Differences are no use, so no pattern exists
Differences hold some patterns, and often fail

explanation.en: The capitals show a real pattern: the country's closeness rose for nine of the ten. Princess shows that a pattern is not a rule. Embeddings come from how words are used, so a sum works sometimes and misses at other times.
